column3: The Hebrew מֶתֶג (a name or phrase, literally “bridle of the mother”) is rendered “control of the chief city”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Restore his hand” is rendered “restore his rule,” and “the river Euphrates” as “the River.”
NASB adds “horses” and “reserved enough of them for.”
“Gave victory to David” is rendered “helped David.”
“Ask him about welfare” is rendered “greet him,” and NASB supplies “Joram brought with him.”
“All Edom” is rendered “all the Edomites,” and “gave victory” as “helped.”
NASB supplies “was over,” and renders “priests” (Hebrew כֹּהֲנִים) as “chief ministers.”
